name: audiopod-studio
description: AudioPod's audio tools for your own recordings: split songs into stems, transcribe with speaker labels and subtitles, convert audio to MIDI, clean up noisy audio, separate speakers, and convert formats. Also creates music, voiceovers, and custom voices.

interface.longDescription:
AudioPod works on the audio you already have. Paste a link to a song, podcast, interview, lecture, or video and ask in plain language: split a track into stems (vocals, drums, bass, piano, guitar) to make an acapella or an instrumental, transcribe it with speaker labels and SRT or VTT subtitles in 100+ languages, convert a melody or a whole song to MIDI for your DAW, remove background noise, give each speaker their own track, or convert between audio and video formats. One job's output can feed the next, so you can clean up a noisy interview and then transcribe it in a single request.

AudioPod can also create audio: voiceovers from text in 200+ languages, original songs, instrumentals, and beats from a description, and custom voices from a sample you have the rights to use.

Good to know:
- AudioPod works from a public or shareable link to your audio (for example a cloud storage share link). It cannot read files on your device; you can also upload files in the AudioPod dashboard.
- Jobs run asynchronously on AudioPod's servers. The assistant starts a job, then checks its status until the output links are ready. Longer files take longer.
- You sign in with your AudioPod account.
- Audio you send is processed on AudioPod's servers and stored under AudioPod's privacy policy.
capabilities: Split songs into stems: vocals, drums, bass, piano, guitar, acapellas, and instrumentals
Transcribe audio and video with speaker labels and SRT or VTT subtitles
Separate speakers into one track each
Create music, songs, and beats from a description
Compose a song you can reshape in plain words before it is recorded
Text to speech voiceovers in 200+ languages
Create custom voices and re-voice recordings
defaultPrompt: Remove the vocals from a song I'll send you a link to.
Transcribe my podcast with speaker labels and SRT subtitles.
Convert this piano recording to MIDI.

positive.description: Remove the vocals from a song (public-domain 1908 recording)
positive.prompt: Remove the vocals from this song so I have an instrumental: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/transcoded/c/cd/MeekerBallGame.ogg/MeekerBallGame.ogg.mp3
positive.expected_behavior: Calls separate_stems with the URL exactly as given and a two-stem mode (2stem_vocals or 2stem_other), polls check_job_status until the job is COMPLETED, then returns every stem link with its label, including the instrumental. Does not claim the stems are ready before COMPLETED and states no prices.

positive.description: Transcribe a short public-domain speech clip with subtitles
positive.prompt: Transcribe this recording and give me SRT subtitles: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/transcoded/d/dd/Armstrong_Small_Step.ogg/Armstrong_Small_Step.ogg.mp3
positive.expected_behavior: Calls transcribe_audio with the URL and format srt, polls check_job_status until COMPLETED, then calls check_job_status with include_format srt and returns the SRT text from the result. Never invents transcript text.

positive.description: Convert a public-domain solo piano recording to MIDI
positive.prompt: Convert this piano recording to MIDI: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/transcoded/9/90/Erik_Satie_-_gymnopedies_-_la_1_ere._lent_et_douloureux.ogg/Erik_Satie_-_gymnopedies_-_la_1_ere._lent_et_douloureux.ogg.mp3
positive.expected_behavior: Calls audio_to_midi with the URL exactly as given, polls check_job_status with tool audio_to_midi until COMPLETED, and returns the MIDI file links from the result. Never invents a download URL.

positive.description: Clean up background noise on a public-domain recording
positive.prompt: Remove the background noise from this clip: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/transcoded/d/dd/Armstrong_Small_Step.ogg/Armstrong_Small_Step.ogg.mp3
positive.expected_behavior: Calls denoise_audio with the URL exactly as given, polls check_job_status until COMPLETED, and returns the cleaned audio link.

positive.description: Check the remaining credit balance on the connected account
positive.prompt: How many AudioPod credits do I have left?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_account and reports the plan name, the available credit balance, and the renewal date if present, using only the returned values. Does not link a pricing, plans, or billing page, does not suggest upgrading or buying or adding credits, and states no prices.

negative.description: General music-theory question that needs no audio processing
negative.prompt: What is the difference between a major and a minor chord?

negative.description: Transcription request with no link to the audio
negative.prompt: Transcribe the file on my desktop.
Book me a flight to Paris next Friday.

review.commerce_description: No purchases happen in ChatGPT: users sign in to an existing AudioPod account and use the features already on it. When a feature is not on their plan or their credits run out, the plugin only says so, with no plans shown, no upgrade prompts and no purchase links.
